# Course Schedule

**Fall 2026 — Monday / Wednesday / Friday.** The 20-notebook arc is paced across the semester. **Mondays and Wednesdays carry the course content; every Friday is a studio session dedicated to the final-project poster and/or the Course Case Competition.** Lecture content completes on **Mon Oct 26**, the **Undergraduate Research Conference poster presentation is Tue Nov 17** (all students present, final poster due Tue Nov 10), and the **Poster-to-Product** build sprint runs through early December. Final-project milestone due dates are listed in the table below the schedule.

The **Notebook** column names the notebook (`nbNN`) anchored to each session — click the badge to open it in Google Colab. The **Track** column marks what the session is for: *Content* (new notebook material), *Lab* (applied clinic), *Poster* and *Competition* (Friday studios and project work), *P2P* (the post-conference Poster-to-Product sprint). Sessions with `—` in the Notebook column carry no new notebook.

## Final Project Milestones

Group capstone (groups of four). Deliverables are due **Sundays, 11:59 PM** (the project track runs alongside the MWF sessions), except the final poster, pinned to **Tue Nov 10** — 7 days before the conference. Full instructions and rubrics: [`_final_project/2026F/`](https://github.com/davi-moreira/2026F_predictive_analytics_QM474/tree/main/_final_project/2026F). *(Milestone numbering follows the reference documents; M04 / M07 / M13 are intentionally unused.)*

## Course Case Competition

The **Fall 2026 QM47400 Case Competition (Bank Churn)** on Kaggle opens **Mon Aug 24** and runs the whole semester alongside the course. Friday studios marked *Competition* are dedicated work sessions; the competition concludes with an **online work session on Mon Nov 23** and a **final submission deadline of Sun Nov 29, 11:59 PM** — the Sunday of Thanksgiving week, and the last day submissions are accepted on the platform.

## Core Course References

- **James, Witten, Hastie, Tibshirani.** *An Introduction to Statistical Learning* (ISLP) + Python labs. Download: [https://www.statlearning.com/](https://www.statlearning.com/){target="_blank"}
- **Hastie, Tibshirani, Friedman.** *The Elements of Statistical Learning* (ESL).
- **Provost, Fawcett.** *Data Science for Business*.
- **Pedregosa et al.** "Scikit-learn: Machine Learning in Python." *JMLR*.
- **scikit-learn User Guide** (pipelines, preprocessing, model selection, metrics, inspection).
- **Chip Huyen.** *Designing Machine Learning Systems* (deployment thinking, monitoring).
